title: Undergraduate Research (UT Dallas Office of Undergraduate Education)
organization: The University of Texas at Dallas
description:
The Office of Undergraduate Education's research unit is UT Dallas's hub for undergraduate research, helping students of every major find faculty mentors, join labs and scholarly projects, secure research funding, and present their work. It connects prospective researchers with opportunities across the sciences, engineering, arts, and humanities and explains how to get started.

title: Undergraduate Research Scholar Awards (UT Dallas)
organization: The University of Texas at Dallas
description: The Undergraduate Research Scholar Awards (URSA) are competitive awards from the Office of Undergraduate Education that recognize UT Dallas undergraduate researchers and support their professional development. Recipients receive a monetary award tied to participation in the URSA poster competition held each spring, showcasing faculty-mentored research across disciplines.

title: Patti Henry Pinch Scholarship for Undergraduate Research (UT Dallas)
organization: The University of Texas at Dallas
description: The Patti Henry Pinch Scholarship helps UT Dallas undergraduates cover research and travel expenses through supplemental financial support, jointly funded by the student's school and the Office of Undergraduate Education. It is intended to fund research activities where other sources of support are inadequate or unavailable, so students can pursue and present mentored research.
